chunks: Throwing at the unseen from afar, and guessing by conjecture that missed the mark,
The sons of vanity, the brothers of tribalism, and the horsemen of pride and ignorance confirmed it to be true.
So when the unruly ones among you submitted to him, and his greed for you became firmly established,
and the situation emerged from the hidden secret to the clear fact, his authority spread strongly over you, and he advanced with his forces towards you,
ai.seo_question: How did Satan deceive humanity according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali details how Satan’s deception relies on 'ghayb' (the unseen) and 'zann' (conjecture), exploiting the tribal pride ('hamiyyah') of early Muslims to establish a foothold. This passage serves as a critical warning in Shia scholarship that vanity and group loyalty can transform subtle spiritual whispers into overt political and social dominance, as seen in the gradual consolidation of power after the Prophet's era.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Although he (Satan) had said so only by guessing about the unknown future and by wrong conjecturing,
yet the sons of vanity, the brothers of haughtiness and the horsemen of pride and intolerance proved him to be true,
so much so that when disobedient persons from among you bowed before him, and his greed about you gained strength;
and what was a hidden secret turned into a clear fact, he spread his full control over you and marched with his forces towards you.
